title: Barn to Be Wild: Casey’s NEW Barn Burner Chicken Pizza
summary: Casey’s Pizza Competition winner, the Barn Burner Chicken Pizza brings the heat with bold flavor! See if it’s available at a Casey’s near you.
body_markdown:
## Meet Terrell Banks, the creative force behind this season's standout pizza! ****


Casey’s annual Pizza Competition was nothing short of sizzling last year, but one innovative pizza stole the spotlight. Terrell Banks, Division Manager in the Indianapolis area, brought the heat with his fiery masterpiece: **The Barn Burner Chicken Pizza** .


From the very first bite, it was clear this pizza was *barn to be wild* . Terrell’s bold combination of flavors earned him well‑deserved bragging rights as the champion of pizza innovation.


**Find a location near you to order the Barn Burner Chicken Pizza**


[Try Now](https://www.caseys.com/menu/c/pizza?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=caseysblog&utm_campaign=barnburnerblog)[Find a Store](https://www.caseys.com/locations)


**Q: Where are you from? Where is your Casey's store located?**


A: I'm from Indianapolis, IN born and raised. My home store is in Yorktown, IN.


**Q: What inspired you to create the Barn Burner?**


A: I can't take full credit for this pizza, it originated with the team at Store 3552 in Fort Loramie, Ohio. I just made a few modifications to further enhance the flavor profile.


**Q: Which topping or ingredient do you think is the “star” of the Barn Burner?**


A: Definitely the Sriracha. It brings a heat that keeps you coming back for another slice.


**Q: How would you describe this pizza to our guests?**


A: It's the perfect balance of sweet and spicy. If you love a little kick and enjoy BBQ, this pizza is for you.


**Q: What do you think people will love about this pizza?**


A: The flavor! Sriracha paired with BBQ sauce creates a unique "sweet heat" that really stands out.


[Try Now](https://www.caseys.com/menu/c/pizza?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=caseysblog&utm_campaign=barnburnerblog)


###


### What makes it a barn burner?


- **Base:** A kick of Sriracha sauce sets the tone.
- **Protein:** Juicy grilled chicken paired with crispy bacon.
- **Cheese:** A melty duo of real mozzarella and sharp cheddar.
- **Veggies:** Red onion and jalapeños for crunch and spice.
- **Finish:** A post‑bake drizzle of Sweet Baby Ray’s BBQ sauce ties it all together.


This isn’t a pizza you keep in the coop—it’s one that breaks free, blazing with flavor. Try the Barn Burner at your local Casey's today!
